# 🧩 Documentation Templates

| Template | Use |
|---|---|
| [Architecture](architecture-template.md) | Record a design review or architecture change |
| [Feature specification](feature-specification-template.md) | Propose a report capability |
| [Bug report](bug-report-template.md) | Report a reproducible issue |
| [QA test case](qa-test-case-template.md) | Define one test scenario |
| [Test plan](test-plan-template.md) | Plan release regression coverage |
| [Test report](test-report-template.md) | Record executed results |
| [Threat assessment](threat-assessment-template.md) | Review an asset or workflow risk |
| [Security audit](security-audit-template.md) | Record an evidence-based review |
| [Accessibility audit](accessibility-audit-template.md) | Review report accessibility |
| [Deployment](deployment-checklist.md) | Handoff or publish an approved report |
| [Rollback](rollback-checklist.md) | Restore a known-good release |
| [Migration](migration-template.md) | Change a source schema or report version |
| [Change request](change-request-template.md) | Assess impact before implementation |
| [Code review](code-review-template.md) | Review report or repository changes |
| [Project status](project-status-template.md) | Report progress and blockers |
| [Meeting notes](meeting-notes-template.md) | Preserve decisions and actions |
| [Maintenance](maintenance-checklist.md) | Run routine upkeep |
| [Data dictionary](data-dictionary-template.md) | Profile workbook fields |

Replace instructions with evidence. Never leave fictional test results or sample values that could be mistaken for real results.
